title: CI farm substrate history replaced by GitHub bridge plus native oya-ci target
purpose: Preserve the useful hyperscaler CI-farm patterns from ADR-0349 without keeping a retired external CI controller or its Kubernetes manifests as active interim authority. The current bridge is GitHub/GitHub Actions under ADR-0516; the permanent destination is native Oyatie SCM plus rust-prow/oya-ci/cloud-workspace/release-conveyor seams. Buck2 remains build/test/check authority throughout.

authority_limits: no retired external SCM/CI/CD substrate is interim authority
no manual required-status bridge is merge authority
GitHub Actions CD is dry-run/evidence only until native release conveyor cutover

native_destination.scm: Oyatie SCM: Sapling-inspired Rust implementation or fork/reimplementation decision by evidence
native_destination.ci: rust-prow/oya-ci with Prow capability parity plus Oyatie improvements
native_destination.build_authority: Buck2 affected/full target closure and Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage
native_destination.merge_authority_context: oya-ci-required after trusted controller/trunk evidence exists
native_destination.delivery: native release conveyor with signed provenance, canary, bake-time SLO, and rollback evidence
native_destination.workspace_model: cloud workspace service with isolated worktrees/lanes and low shared-file surface

preserved_patterns.destination: Buck2 remote execution/cache or native cache service; no Cargo protected-branch authority
preserved_patterns.notes: Cargo metadata may feed generated Buck2 graphs; local Cargo mutation output is advisory only.

preserved_patterns.destination: GitHub bridge now; native Tide/merge-queue adapter after oya-ci cutover
preserved_patterns.conflict_mitigation: vertical lanes own disjoint files; shared workflow/config surfaces are pointer-thin or generated from registries

preserved_patterns.destination: Buck2-built artifacts with cosign/SLSA/SBOM evidence through native release conveyor

non_claims: This supersession record does not deploy native oya-ci, native SCM, cloud workspaces, remote execution/cache, or release conveyor.
This record does not mutate live GitHub branch protection, Kubernetes workloads, cloud accounts, or secrets.
This record does not claim P0.0/Phase-0 green; native producer/source-bound evidence remains required.
